_comment: What a voice says on its test screen and in its recorded sample (tools/make_samples.py): by its locale, else its language. [a compact voice, an enhanced or premium one]; {name} its name, {version} where it is from (iOS 6, Mac OS X Mavericks). Where the version would have to be inflected, the sentence names the system instead, so the name stays as written.
